{{Quote|Sav is a legend among the Brotherhood. We stranded him in the snow once and left him for dead in wampa country. He strangled one with a tauntaun femur and skinned it with its own claws. He showed up in the ice fortress weeks later, quite alive.|Captain Biron|<ref name="GTAI" />}}
Master '''Sav''' was a muscular [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and the leader of the [[Hailstorm Brotherhood]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] sect operating on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. He survived multiple death scenarios: for example, even when all his men were [[Death/Legends|killed]] at the [[Battle of High Ridge]], he survived and went on to hunt [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]] with a spear made from the icicle. He was eventually killed during the [[Galactic War]], and his pirate group disbanded.<ref name="Hailstorm" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sav is a character in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. If the player is Republic, both Republic and Empire collaborate to defeat Sav.<ref name="GTAI" /> If the player is Empire, only the Empire confronts Sav, and the player can choose to either attack him and his guards immediately (Dark Side) or agree to face him alone in a duel in a sub-zero ice cave called "The Pit" (Light Side).<ref name="Hailstorm" />
